title: Columbo
description:
S9 E4 — Rest in Peace, Mrs. Columbo
When a crooked estate agent dies in prison, his widow vows to exact her revenge on the two men that put him there. After killing her husband's informing boss, she sets her sights on Lieutenant Columbo.

title: Columbo
description:
S9 E5 — Uneasy Lies the Crown
A dentist frames his wife for a murder in order to keep up his image and expensive lifestyle.

title: Columbo
description:
S9 E6 — Murder in Malibu
A famous romance novelist is shot dead in the course of what looks like a robbery.

title: Columbo
description:
S10 E1 — Columbo Goes to College
The rumpled lieutenant is invited to give a college lecture on criminology but ends up investigating the murder of one of the institution's professors.

title: Columbo
description:
S10 E2 — Caution: Murder Can Be Hazardous to Your Health
Columbo investigates the murder of a crime show host's rival with incriminating evidence.

title: Columbo
description:
S10 E3 — Columbo and the Murder of a Rock Star
Columbo is put to the test against an equally brilliant, criminal defense lawyer who murders his rock star girlfriend.

title: Columbo
description:
S10 E4 — Death Hits the Jackpot
A police detective questions a jewelry-store owner whose late nephew had a winning lottery ticket.

title: Columbo
description:
S10 E5 — No Time to Die
Columbo attends his nephew's wedding and as the couple get ready to leave on their honeymoon, the bride disappears; Columbo investigates and suspects his nephew may have made a few enemies on the police force.

title: Columbo
description:
S10 E6 — A Bird in the Hand..
Columbo investigates a hit-and-run, followed by a car explosion.

title: Columbo
description:
S10 E7 — It's All in the Game
Two women kill their two-timing lover but have solid alibis; one of the women tries to seduce Columbo to keep him off her trail.

title: Columbo
description:
S10 E8 — Butterfly in Shades of Grey
Columbo investigates a case involving argumentative radio talk show host Fielding Chase.

title: Columbo
description:
S10 E9 — Undercover
The disheveled detective sets out to solve an unusual double murder in which two men have apparently killed each other.

title: Columbo
description:
S10 E11 — A Trace of Murder
Columbo matches wits with a forensics specialist, helping his girlfriend to frame her husband for a stockbroker's murder.
